strategies.name: Relative-strength rotation
strategies.description: Ranks positive 6h and 24h momentum across the live universe, adjusted for volatility and BTC-relative strength.

strategies.name: Range recovery
strategies.description: Looks for confirmed recovery after a meaningful drawdown with room back toward the recent range high.

strategies.name: Trend pullback continuation
strategies.description: Buys a controlled pullback and completed-hour reclaim inside an established uptrend.

strategies.name: Volatility compression breakout
strategies.description: Looks for a low-volatility coil followed by a completed-hour breakout with volume expansion.

strategies.name: Liquidity-sweep rebound
strategies.description: Looks for a downside range sweep that closes back inside the range with supportive current book imbalance.

strategies.name: Breadth-thrust rotation
strategies.description: Trades leaders only when a broad share of the crypto universe is advancing together.

strategies.name: Leader-laggard catch-up
strategies.description: Looks for positive-trend coins beginning to accelerate after lagging the median short-horizon move.

strategies.name: Capitulation recovery
strategies.description: Looks for high-volume exhaustion after a deep drawdown followed by completed-hour recovery confirmation.

strategies.name: Defensive relative strength
strategies.description: Tests whether a liquid coin holding its trend during a falling BTC regime offers a better long-only outcome than cash.

strategies.name: Volume-weighted value recovery
strategies.description: Tests a confirmed recovery below the prior 72-hour volume-weighted price, with the measured value gap paying for round-trip costs.

strategies.name: Weekend participation breakout
